verdict.rationale: stagewise documents bring-your-own-key (BYOK) setup. Configuring your own provider API keys for every provider lets you "skip authentication entirely," with no requests going through the stagewise managed service. That directly replaces the stagewise Account login with API keys, and providers can be configured individually. Community complaints about sign-up and onboarding concern account creation, not the BYOK path, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the app runs fully without an account login, and detail on whether any stagewise-issued API key exists as opposed to third-party provider keys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: Skip authentication entirely by configuring BYOK for every provider you use. No requests go through the stagewise managed service
Bring your existing API keys and use them directly in stagewise.
Each provider is configured independently. A typical setup: Anthropic → Official API (your key); OpenAI → stagewise Account
